message: I think I found it, this site says no matter what phone service you have they will give you sevice for your loved one to call and it is very cheap also, cheaper than what i have seen n-e-where. Here is the web site http://www.outsideconnectioninc.net they say it doesn't matter what phone sevice you have. Their site says they can set you up if you have a cell phone, VOIP phone, if your long distance provider won't allow you to recieve collect calls, and etc. it doesn't matter. I think this service is strictly for calls from inmates. Just look over the site. The guy that ownes this phone sevice was in prison and noticed how much money it cost his family to talk to him and when he got out he wanted to do something about it. So he has gone through what we are going through and it looks like he wants to do something about it. I have researched only a little about this site but plan on doing more and I will write back to show the outcome but what I have seen so far it seems like a good thing. I also seen a little about www.pco.com ( PCO stands for Prison Calls Online and people came here from MCI ) and their are alot of people that were subcribed to that site that have switched to Outside Connections I know we all are looking for a good and cheap phone seviceto talk to our loved ones and I ran across this one and decided to share it with you hope it helps.
